about: Dated price table of the study harness. Dollars are derived from token counts with this table and never stored as raw data. Prices are USD per million tokens. Re-read both vendors' pricing pages at pilot time and change `dated` and the figures in a new file. This table follows prices.json (dated 2026-10-20), which stays as it was for the runs that name it: only the cache-write price of gpt-6.1-sol changed.

claude-sonnet-5-5.source: read from the Anthropic pricing page on 2026-10-20: input 2, five-minute cache write 2.50, cache hit 0.10 (0.05 times the input price for this model), output 10

gpt-6.1-sol.source: OpenAI pricing page developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing read 2026-11-21, Standard tab, short context (up to 272K input tokens): input 2.00, cached input 0.10, 30m write 2.50, 12h write 5.00, output 10.00. The cache write is the 30-minute price: the prompt-caching guide developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/prompt-caching (read 2026-11-21) says the default lifetime is 30 minutes and the harness sets no lifetime; the Responses API reports the writes in usage.input_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens
